processors.script: const forwardedRequest = context.getProperty("forward_http_request") || ""; let body = context.getBody(); const statusCode = parseInt(context.getProperty("status_code") || "200", 10); const reusedForwardedRequest = typeof body === "string" && body === forwardedRequest; if (reusedForwardedRequest) { body = ""; } context.setProperty("useResponse", "true"); context.setBody(JSON.stringify({ statusCode, headers: { "content-type": "application/json" }, body: body || "", isBase64Encoded: false }));
